notes: Historical financials (revenue and EBIT): revenue and “EBIT” are mapped to consolidated revenues and total consolidated operating income (“income from operations”) from the FY2025 Form 10-K. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))

Depreciation & amortization (DA) for historical years uses the consolidated D&A total provided in the segment disclosure table in the FY2025 10-K (converted from thousands to full units). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))

Capex uses the FY cash flow line “Capital expenditures” (cash outflow), converted from thousands to full units. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))

NWC construction: NWC is computed from year-end balance-sheet totals using NWC = (Total current assets − cash and cash equivalents) − (Total current liabilities − current portion of debt). This excludes cash and removes current debt from working capital. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate is set to 0.19 (rounded) using the company’s reported effective tax rate (18.7% in 2025 and 19.6% in 2024). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))
WACC is a modeling assumption (not directly disclosed in the filings). Terminal assumptions: terminal_growth=0.02 and terminal_exit_ebitda_multiple=13.5; terminal_method='average'.

NOL balance: only foreign net operating loss carryforwards “tax effect” is directly retrievable from the deferred tax footnote; nol_balance is set to 59.096M (tax-effect) rather than the gross NOL principal, and nol_utilization_pct is set to 0.80 as a conservative utilization assumption. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))
Comps: EV/NTM revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were not populated from a consistent primary/official dataset in this run; therefore comps fields are null and explained in each peer note.

catalysts: Sustained cost discipline/Lean AI-driven productivity translating into continued operating-income margin resilience.
Operating leverage if freight volumes and pricing stabilize post-divestiture effects.
Capital allocation execution (share repurchases and dividends) supported by recurring operating cash flow.
company_overview: Global third-party logistics provider connecting customers with carriers across truckload, LTL, ocean, air, and more.
Uses proprietary technology and a “Lean AI” approach to improve matching, productivity, and supply-chain outcomes.

Serves a large customer base (83,000 customers) and a broad carrier network (450,000 contract carriers). ([investor.chrobinson.com](https://investor.chrobinson.com/News-and-Events/Press-Releases/press-release-details/2026/C-H--Robinson-Reports-2025-Fourth-Quarter-Results/default.aspx))
current_context: Full-year 2025 revenues declined to $16.2B, largely influenced by the Europe Surface Transportation divestiture and mix/price pressures. ([investor.chrobinson.com](https://investor.chrobinson.com/News-and-Events/Press-Releases/press-release-details/2026/C-H--Robinson-Reports-2025-Fourth-Quarter-Results/default.aspx))

2025 income from operations increased to ~$795.0M driven by lower operating expense, with margin improvement. ([investor.chrobinson.com](https://investor.chrobinson.com/News-and-Events/Press-Releases/press-release-details/2026/C-H--Robinson-Reports-2025-Fourth-Quarter-Results/default.aspx))

Company guided 2026 effective tax rate of 18% to 20% and expects 2026 capital expenditures of $75M to $85M. ([investor.chrobinson.com](https://investor.chrobinson.com/News-and-Events/Press-Releases/press-release-details/2026/C-H--Robinson-Reports-2025-Fourth-Quarter-Results/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base-case EBIT margin recovery is anchored in the observed operating-income improvement from 2023 to 2025, then held near ~5.0% in the forecast. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))

Capital intensity is modeled as low and relatively stable (capex ~0.4%–0.5% of sales), consistent with historical cash capital expenditures. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))

Working-capital intensity is modeled around ~5% of sales using a balance-sheet NWC construction that excludes cash and adjusts for current debt. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))
Terminal assumptions (2.0% growth and ~13.5x exit EBITDA multiple) reflect long-run maturity typical for asset-light logistics platforms.
key_risks: Freight-cycle deterioration (volume and/or pricing) reducing adjusted gross profit and operating leverage.
Working-capital swings (receivables/payables dynamics) that reduce free cash flow versus base-case.
Margin pressure from competition, carrier cost volatility, and fuel/pass-through dynamics.

valuation_summary: DCF uses normalized margins and a modest growth profile that transitions from the 2025 base to a steadier long-run rate (no aggressive step-ups).
Terminal value is supported by a sustainable 2.0% terminal growth assumption and an economically sensible terminal EBITDA multiple for logistics/3PL businesses.
Equity bridge inputs use reported cash and total debt as of Dec 31, 2025. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1043277/000104327726000009/chrw-20251231.htm))
